newsitem.title: USA: USDA accepts DEIP bids to Africa and Middle East.
newsitem.headline: USDA accepts DEIP bids to Africa and Middle East.

text.p: The U.S. Agriculture Department Friday said it accepted bids to sell nonfat dry milk and mozzarella cheese to Africa and the Middle East.
USDA said it accepted a bid from Agri-Best Dairy Products Inc to sell 340 tonnes of nonfat dry milk. The bonus was $817 per tonne and delivery was set for Jan. 17 - April 19.
The department also said it accepted a bid from Fast Food Merchandisers Inc to sell 14 tonnes of mozzarella. The bonus is $550 per tonne. Delivery was set for Jan. 17 - April 16.
USDA said the DEIP balance for those areas for mozzarella is 1,995 tonnes and for nonfat dry milk, 16,334 tonnes.
